'''Solen Kove''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked for the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] as [[Director/Legends|Director]] of the [[Department of Merchant Safety and Security]]. He was present on [[Dorumaa]] when [[Cyreno Taegon]] (the company [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]]) hired some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to investigate the murder of [[Rysko Barnt]], which the company [[President/Legends|President]], [[Echari Di'San]] had been implicated in causing.
